name: Vladislav Nagornyi
text: Great experience renting a motorbike! The process was smooth, the bike was in excellent condition, and the staff was super friendly and helpful. Highly recommend for exploring the area!

name: Purujeet Singh Yadav
text: One of the best Motorbike rentals in DaNang. Have a great fleet of expensive bikes as well as affordable scooters. 100% recommended 👍🏻

name: Matrice300
text: Quang NGA motorbike rental is a fantastic family run business that goes beyond just renting you a bike, they actually care for and treat you as part of their family. They go above and beyond with their service and support, the bikes are well maintained, helmets are provided and they give you a full rundown on how the bike and accessories work. Rental prices were the best I had found, coupled with the exceptional service provided, I can highly recommend renting with Quang NGA. My warmest thanks.

name: yong wook kim
text: I've been here four times The motorcycle is so clean and the owner is so kind and nice Yesterday, the battery was discharged, and it was solved quickly I'm going to revisit this place again, which I'm very moved by
